newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE SAYS RAKVERE TO RESTART SOON.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE SAYS RAKVERE TO RESTART SOON.

text.p: The Tallinn stock exchange said on Wednesday that share trade in Rakvere, suspended amid allegations of insider dealing, will restart soon.
The bourse earlier suspended the stock after the securities commission said that at its request the police have initiated criminal charges for alleged insider dealing.
"We wanted the information to spread calmly...so that investors could have time to read the information," bourse managing director Helo Meigas told Reuters.
"The suspension will most probably not last long but certainly for the whole of today," she added.
She said that trade would start in the near future, depending on further comments by the securities commission.
Rakvere shares rose sharply on May 14 and May 15 and the company before the close of trade on May 15 announced it was buying a majority stake in Latvian meat plant Rigas Miesnieks.
